pages.text: Ethereal, Dark Ethereal, and Ineffable Glass let players walk through upright. They block mobs and sneaking players. Inverted Ineffable Glass reverses that passage rule: stand to stay on it, sneak to pass through.

pages.title: Light and Passage
pages.text: Use Dark Ethereal Glass where you want to block light while allowing upright players through. Ordinary Ethereal and both Ineffable variants let light through.$(br2)Pair them with normal glass to set boundaries and access points.
